title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
shortDescription: Lead and build real-world software projects end to end while shaping technical direction across Mosaiq.
description:
As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer at Mosaiq, you are expected to hit the ground running. This role is for individuals with strong, practical experience in modern web development who genuinely enjoy building software and thinking deeply about systems.

You will initiate and own projects, propose new ideas, improve existing systems, and set technical standards through example. While mentorship is not your primary job, your experience naturally elevates those around you. You are someone who explores problems proactively, cares about code quality and architecture, and treats Mosaiq like a real engineering environment, not a resume line.

This role offers significant autonomy, creative freedom, and the chance to build meaningful software with other highly motivated builders.
requirements: Strong practical experience with React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript
Solid backend experience with Node.js and Express
Comfortable designing and building full-stack systems end to end
Experience working with real-world codebases beyond coursework
Ability to independently drive projects from idea to execution
Strong time management and ability to balance Mosaiq with other commitments
Clear passion for software engineering and building things that matter
niceToHave: Experience with WebSockets or real-time systems
Familiarity with Svelte
Experience with system design and architecture decisions
Exposure to DevOps or deployment workflows (CI/CD, Docker)
Experience reviewing code or setting technical direction

applicationQuestions.question: Why do you want to be part of Mosaiq specifically?
Tell us about a project you drove largely on your own. What decisions did you make, and what did you learn?
What keeps you excited about software engineering outside of classes?
How do you usually look for ways to improve an existing codebase or product?

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
shortDescription: Build and ship real software while rapidly growing as an engineer in a professional, collaborative environment.
description:
As a Full-Stack Software Engineer at Mosaiq, you will work on real software projects alongside experienced peers in an environment that mirrors how modern engineering teams operate.

This role is ideal for those who already have exposure to web development and are eager to level up quickly. You are not expected to know everything on day one, but you are expected to care deeply, learn fast, and contribute meaningfully. Mosaiq values curiosity, effort, and ownership far more than checklists of technologies.

You will move between projects based on your interests and learning goals, gaining experience across the full stack while building software that actually gets used.
requirements: Prior experience with web development beyond introductory coursework
Working knowledge of JavaScript and modern frontend development
Some exposure to React and/or TypeScript
Basic understanding of backend concepts (APIs, servers, data flow)
Comfortable using Git and collaborating in shared codebases
Strong willingness to learn and improve rapidly
Ability to balance Mosaiq with academics and other commitments
niceToHave: Experience with Node.js and Express
Experience with Svelte
Exposure to WebSockets or real-time features
Interest in system design and architecture
Comfort reading and navigating larger codebases

applicationQuestions.question: What originally pulled you into building software?
Describe a project where you had to learn something unfamiliar to make progress.
What does "getting better as an engineer" mean to you right now?
How do you usually balance demanding commitments when things get busy?

title: UI / Product Designer
shortDescription: Design intuitive, thoughtful interfaces and help shape how users experience Mosaiq-built software.
description:
As a UI / Product Designer at Mosaiq, you will shape how users experience the software we build. This role sits at the intersection of design, usability, and engineering.

You may focus primarily on design, or you may also choose to contribute technically, this role is highly flexible by nature. Designers at Mosaiq are not siloed; you will work closely with engineers, influence product decisions, and see your designs implemented in real applications.

This role is for people who care deeply about how software feels to use, enjoy thinking through user problems, and want their design work to exist beyond static mockups.
requirements: Demonstrated interest or experience in UI, UX, or product design
Ability to communicate design decisions clearly
Experience with design tools such as Figma or equivalent
Understanding of core design principles (layout, hierarchy, usability)
Strong collaboration skills with engineers
Interest in how design translates into real software
niceToHave: Basic HTML/CSS or frontend experience
Experience designing web applications
Understanding of accessibility considerations
Experience prototyping interactive flows
Interest in bridging design and implementation

applicationQuestions.question: What excites you about designing software products?
Share a design you are proud of and explain the thinking behind it.
How do you like to work with engineers?
What skills are you hoping to grow through Mosaiq?

title: Research Scientist
shortDescription: Explore open-ended technical questions and turn research ideas into working prototypes and experiments.
description:
As a Research Scientist at Mosaiq, you will investigate open-ended technical questions and explore emerging ideas, often at the intersection of theory and practice.

This role is more exploratory and academic in nature, but still grounded in building. Research may involve experiments, prototypes, simulations, or small applications that test ideas in areas such as AI, human-computer interaction, algorithms, or related fields.

This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy asking "why" and "what if," reading deeply, experimenting, and turning abstract ideas into something tangible.
requirements: Strong curiosity and interest in technical research
Ability to think analytically about complex problems
Experience programming in at least one language (Python preferred)
Comfort reading technical documentation or papers
Ability to work independently and communicate findings clearly
Strong intrinsic motivation to explore unanswered questions
niceToHave: Experience with Python-based research or experimentation
Interest in AI or machine learning
Experience building small prototypes or proof-of-concepts
Interest in human-computer interaction or UX research
Experience writing technical explanations or reports

applicationQuestions.question: What kinds of technical questions do you find yourself thinking about most?
Tell us about a time you explored a problem simply because you were curious.
How do you usually approach something you don’t fully understand yet?
What motivates you to dig deeper into a topic?
